snippet.title: F22 ADF (Air Dominance Fighter) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Some flight training and a dogfight.
Download for modern OS: https://web.archive.org/web/20220121170024/https://community.combatsim.com/topic/20202-f-22-total-air-war-230-final-released/

128MB RAM
8MB Video Memory (Used software renderer)
